title: Equality of matching counts
statement: For all natural numbers $r$ and $k$, the number of perfect matchings in the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part equals the number of perfect matching codes of length parameter $(2rk)/2$ whose decoded pairs lie in distinct parts.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is complete $2r$-partite with $k$ vertices in each part
Every decoded pair in the counted codes joins vertices from distinct parts
